fields.text: Utility outage. Both mains (MV-A and MV-B) tripped on utility undervoltage at 16:14. All 7 generators carried the site; no IT impact.

Generators in cool-down and back to auto. Closed.

fields.label: Long description
fields.text: Rack A07 lost both feeds during MOP-310. The A-side tap-off TO-A07-A was open for the retorque; the B-side tap-off TO-A07-B was opened at 10:42, leaving the rack with no input power. Unit Rack A07, Hall A.

entries.text: BMS alarm acknowledged: rack input power lost (both feeds). TO-A07-B found open alongside TO-A07-A, which was open for MOP-310.
In Hall A at the busway. Stopped the MOP work. TO-A07-B is the B-side unit next to the A-side one being retorqued.
B tap-off unit failed on reclose and was replaced. TO-A07-B closed; B-side feed to rack A07 restored. Handoff to the IT Partner (INC3900001).
Retorque finished; TO-A07-A closed. Both feeds live.
Closed. Rack A07 on both feeds.

Replaced the B tap-off unit, closed TO-A07-B, finished the retorque, closed TO-A07-A
